recs.stt: “Don Knuth Plays with ChatGPT” but with ChatGPT-4
recs.x:
of ChatGPT, which only knows things up to September 2021. It could now read the news daily and "keep up".

7. External script harnesses that run multiple LLMs in parallel, with different prompts and/or different system messages. Some optimised for "idea generation", some optimised for "task completion", and then finally models tuned for "review and verification". Almost like a human team, multiple ideas can be generated, merged, reviewed, planned out, and then actioned. Check out "smol developer", which utilises Anthropic's 100K context window for this: [link]
